preconditions.description: Attacker must have a valid signed permit from a token owner on another chain (e.g., Ethereum mainnet)
The DOMAIN_SEPARATOR must be computed without proper chainId validation (using chainid() opcode which returns the current chain's ID)

exploit_hint: Obtain a signed permit (v, r, s) for token transfer on a different chain (e.g., Ethereum mainnet) where the DOMAIN_SEPARATOR was computed with that chain's chainId. Replay the same signature on BSC by calling permit() with the same parameters. The signature will validate because DOMAIN_SEPARATOR uses chainid() which returns BSC's chainId (56) instead of being hardcoded to prevent cross-chain replay. This allows unauthorized token transfers via permit.
